findings.title: Supabase service_role key used in application code (bypasses RLS)
findings.fixPrompt:
Fix one warning security issue that DeployReady found in this project.

Where: lib/supabase.ts:6
Issue: Supabase service_role key used in application code (bypasses RLS) (CWE-269, A01:2025)
What to change: The service_role key bypasses Row-Level Security. Use it only in trusted server-side code (never in client/browser bundles), and prefer the anon key + RLS policies for user-facing access.

Keep the fix minimal: change only what this issue needs, do not change behaviour or refactor unrelated code, and never put real secrets in code or in your reply (use environment variables).
To confirm: re-run `npx deployready@latest analyze` and check this issue is gone, or call the DeployReady MCP `verify` tool with id "278b7d1ade01".
